name: 0.6.7a demo
body:
- Dialogues with bosses
- New original soundtrack by RigidatoMS
- Revised levels
- Title screen
- Integer scale and soft scale display options
- Bugfixes

For more details see https://ioribranford.itch.io/demonizer/devlog

name: 0.4.0c demo
body:
This is a bugfix and minor improvement release.

* Enemies turn redder as they take more damage.
* Checkpoint system for longer stages. Chapel stage has one inside the chapel.
* Fixed regression where after completing a stage, player team's power gauges showed the wrong values.
